remarks: Discover a unique opportunity to live in a beautifully remodeled 2 bedroom, 1 bath top-floor apartment with private entry and private staircase, surrounded by gorgeously landscaped grounds. This spacious apartment features a sunfilled living and dining area with large windows that fill the rooms with natural light. A large private patio opens from the living room-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The apartment offers 2 well-proportioned bedrooms, including a walk-in closet, as well as beautiful hardwood floors and fresh paint throughout the apartment. The eat-in kitchen is equipped with new appliances. Nice full bath. Private, on-site parking for 2 vehicles is available for request and monitored by a surveillance cameras for your peace of mind. Additional large personal storage room/s will be available in the next 6 months. Conveniently located just minutes from vibrant downtown Norwalk and The SoNo Collection. This home combines comfort, style, and convenience. Schedule your private showing and experience all this home has to offer!
